description: Generate an image using Google Gemini image models (Nano Banana Pro). Returns image with inline preview in Claude Desktop and saves full-resolution to disk. Default model: gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro).

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated image

global_media_resolution.description: Global image quality setting for cost optimization (default: HIGH). LOW (280 tokens, 75% savings) - Simple tasks, bulk operations. MEDIUM (560 tokens, 50% savings) - PDFs/documents (OCR saturates at medium). HIGH (1120 tokens) - Best quality, detailed analysis. Can be overridden per-image using mediaResolution in images array.

imageSize.description: Resolution of the generated image (only for image-specific models)

images.description: Optional reference images to guide generation

filePath.description: Local file path to the image (alternative to base64 data). The image is loaded server-side, bypassing MCP transport limits. Use the filePath returned by load_image_from_path.

mediaResolution.description: Per-image resolution override. LOW=280 tokens (75% savings), MEDIUM=560 tokens (50% savings), HIGH=1120 tokens (default), ULTRA_HIGH=2000+ tokens (max detail, per-image only)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg). Required when using data, auto-detected from filePath.

thoughtSignature.description: Thought signature from a previous generate_image or edit_image call. Required for conversational editing with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Pass the thoughtSignature from the previous response to maintain edit context.

model.description: Gemini image model to use (default: gemini-3-pro-image, Nano Banana Pro). Options: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2 — fast), gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image (fastest/cheapest), gemini-3-pro-image-preview, gemini-2.5-flash-image

outputPath.description: Optional file path to save the generated image (e.g., ./output/image.png)

prompt.description: Description of the image to generate

use_search.description: Enable Google Search grounding for data-driven image generation. Use for: weather forecasts, current events, stock prices, sports scores, statistics. The model will search the web for real-time data to inform image generation.

name: generate_image
title: Generate Image with Gemini
